item.text:
The evaluation logic is concentrated in [storage/rule.go](/app/storage/rule.go:485). Its `RuleStore` interface includes `Evaluate`, and [Server.Evaluate](/app/server/rule.go:163) delegates to that store. [server/server.go](/app/server/server.go:21) constructs the rule store but has no separate evaluator dependency.

The extraction should move flag lookup, rule and constraint loading, typed matching, and distribution selection into `storage/evaluator.go`; remove `Evaluate` from `RuleStore`; and wire an `Evaluator` into `Server`. The current implementation also has behavior to address during that move: it iterates rules from a map despite fetching them by rank, matches operators using their original case after case-insensitive validation, leaves some string comparisons untrimmed, and uses a strict cutoff where the requested bucket boundary is inclusive. Distribution rows have no explicit order.

Existing coverage is in [storage/rule_test.go](/app/storage/rule_test.go:611) and [server/rule_test.go](/app/server/rule_test.go:989). Those tests depend on `RuleStore.Evaluate` and will need migration. The effect of distribution ordering across database engines remains uncertain. I did not run tests or edit project source or tests; this run was limited to fault localization.
